name: praxflow
description: Codex packaging adapter for the portable PraxFlow Agent Skill.

interface.shortDescription: Portable product engineering workflow for multi-repository projects
interface.longDescription: PraxFlow provides one agent-neutral Skill with modes for repository bootstrap, PDF ingestion, system discovery, specification materialization and validation, protocol validation, cross-repository interface change control, system verification, and manifest release. This manifest packages the shared PraxFlow Skill for Codex.
defaultPrompt: Use PraxFlow repo-bootstrap for this repository.
Use PraxFlow pdf-ingest for the PDFs in input/ with source traceability.
Use PraxFlow system-discovery to find contexts and unresolved decisions.
Use PraxFlow protocol-validate before protocol implementation.
